rationale: Roberts is best positioned to craft a narrow, administrable reversal that preserves Omnicare-style half-truth liability while rejecting any de facto duty-to-update theory under Rule 10b-5(b) and Macquarie. A Kagan-led dissent is the most likely vehicle for the minority’s cabined half-truth approach, with Sotomayor and/or Barrett potentially adding separate emphasis on context and present-tense implications.
